summary: NuRAN Wireless filed a Form 6-K furnishing a September 30, 2026 press release on a Nigeria pilot using licensed Starlink LEO satellite backhaul with partner Infratel Africa Limited to lift revenue per rural site. The release cites GSMA's $60.5B 2025 African mobile operator revenue and $90.3B 2030 projection, 122 million uncovered Africans, and 49% rural 4G reach; NuRAN has over 5,000 contracted sites. No securities, ownership, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms are stated; this is an operational update, not a special situation. Watch pilot throughput, uptime and cost-per-capacity results for implications.
